create_icosahedron_mesh: create a regular icosahedral mesh with 12 vertices and 20 triangular faces on a unit sphere
generate_mesh_hierarchy: generate a hierarchy of progressively refined triangular meshes for a sphere with N splits
get_finest_mesh: get the finest resolution triangular mesh for a sphere after N subdivision splits
merge_mesh_hierarchy: merge a sequence of coarse to fine triangular meshes into a single combined mesh
convert_faces_to_edges: convert triangular face indices into sender and receiver edge index arrays for graph operations
